findings.finding: Shp_gift numeric ID is interpreted as public redemption code. Gift public-view branch bypasses saved buyer-token recovery.
findings.reproduce: Evaluate return script ?Shp_kind=gift&Shp_gift=42 -> gift.html?code=42; current gift viewer calls GET /gift/view?code=42.
findings.backend_evidence: /tmp/salon-autoquote-review/app/services/payments.py:865 snapshot; exact current backend parity pending parent confirmation.
findings.fix: Route recognized gift return to gift.html with non-authoritative recovery flag. Recover only using saved id+X-Gift-Token; if missing credential explain return in original tab/use receipt or support, never create duplicate or display paid from URL.

findings.finding: Shp_kind=deposit&Shp_dep=42 has no target. Landing remains animated status=requested although it sends no status request.
findings.fix: Route recognized deposit to dashboard.html#deposit, current workspace supports route and authenticated status.

findings.finding: Analyze DOI A (pending), then new list B: late A overwrites B. Deterministic mock reproduced.
findings.fix: Increment generation on each run and edit; render final result only for same generation. Abort old optional lookups.

findings.finding: Lookup network failure and actual no record share Crossref: record unconfirmed; issue summary excludes failed DOI and can show zero requiring attention despite an issue row.
findings.fix: Show distinct checking/unavailable/not found/found states; unknown is not negative proof. Derive summary from rendered issue status.

findings.finding: 503 retry unresolved HEAD permanently disables button; successful HEAD redirects to home, losing original failed route.
findings.fix: Bound HEAD/abort timeout and re-enable; recover same origin original safe path and nonsecret context; plain reload fallback if scripts fail.

findings.finding: Topic passport writes full text into sessionStorage but no script reads salon_topic_passport; CTA plan.html or configurator drops entered topic.
findings.fix: Remove unused input storage; offer explicit copy/download passport and clear indication text is not auto transferred. Any future handoff must be explicit, time-bound and consumed once.

findings.finding: Claims selected answers remain in browser without qualification; salon-order.js only persists product/scope/discipline/deadline, not topic, name/contact, answers, files.
findings.fix: Use offline page accurate distinction: accepted order server-backed; unsent text and attachments may need entry again.

order ?paid=id supported by salon-workspace, keep money route

check is heuristic readability only, not AI/plagiarism/quality guarantee
remarks-handoff separate module already explicit user initiated + TTL10min + single-use, do not regress
bounded_release: tool analyzer result generation guard, optional DOI with timeout/concurrency/status
public ID-only library shelf + copy/download locally computed reports
guide context-specific CTA product/service allowlist; preserve authoritative guide and price content
